representation.scalar_sorts: Open S : Type and K : S -> Type. Scalars and arrays both retain their sort. Fixed-K prose specializes S to Unit.
representation.shape: Ordered List Axis; each Axis carries existing UID and Nat extent. Coord is the full nested product of Fin extents; rank zero is Unit. ArrayShape excludes rank zero but permits zero extents.
representation.coordinate_interface: Layout carries a Fin count equivalence to the actual Cartesian coordinate type, not an unchecked list. canonicalLayout recursively uses mathlib finProdFinEquiv. Alternative enumeration/storage adapters must supply an equivalence.
representation.declarations: Typed declaration keys with UID injectivity and total signatures. Every Expr.read key is already declared. This is not a source name lookup table or parser/checker.
representation.scope: A typed valuation space Γ; reduction extends Γ by Fin n, tabulation by full Coord. Guarded contexts are subtypes; binders remain product positions, NOT AxisUID identities.
representation.index_language: RawCoord is a correctly ranked signed Int tuple. AdmittedRead retains raw query, value-independent resolver, resolved At/Const outcome, and admission equality. Callbacks are semantic index maps/predicates, NOT checked affine syntax.
representation.selection: Expr.at takes an already bounded typed coordinate map. A raw-index-to-bounded selection adapter is deferred; boundedness is supplied structurally rather than repaired at runtime.
representation.registry: Typed arbitrary-arity dependent argument family, result type, Bool domain, and proof-indexed meaning. Nullary calls share the same rule. Domain/meaning have no store parameter. Executable examples supply decidable domains; arbitrary mathematical domains can be represented noncomputably.
representation.results: Option Value means successful value versus mathematical undefinedness. ReadyResult.notReady is separate from evaluated none. Runtime rejection and backend diagnostics are not modeled.
representation.strictness: sequence traverses the complete finite domain before returning a total function. at evaluates the full array expression. Scalar combination and primitive argument sequencing propagate undefinedness; no zero annihilation shortcut.
representation.numerical_refinement: ScalarOps is operation data, without algebraic laws. Reductions use increasing enumeration and a strict right fold. Exact semiring specialization and native ordered numerical interpretation are distinct; no Float/Float32/complex64 CommSemiring instance.
representation.footprint: List representation retains duplicates; membership determines readiness, so duplicate addresses do not create additional availability conditions. Bound domains and all primitive operands are traversed; constants have no source address.
representation.extra_split: Completeness.lean separates the independent clause equivalence from Readiness. This additional small module is justified by the different proof obligation.
